# Copilot instructions for motion-as-code

## Ground rules

- **No AI footprint in git.** Do not add `Co-authored-by`, `Generated by GitHub Copilot` or any
  similar attribution line to commit messages, PR descriptions, or source files.
- Commits are authored only by the humans who own this repo. Never suggest adding AI attribution.

## Project overview

This repo turns a voiceover script into a 1920×1080 / 60 fps motion-graphics video (TypeScript +
three.js, bun + Vite, headless Chrome renderer). See CLAUDE.md for the full pipeline and plate-writing
guide, README.md for install steps, and CONTRIBUTING.md for the branch workflow.
